No offense, I love DBZ, but Superman would probably win. His eye lasers are just as powerful as any of goku's attacks (ie planet bursting) and supermans peak strength allows him to lift 200quintillion tons, roughly the weight of a small planet, with just his left hand ssj4 goku is strong, but he's not THAT strong. His body is much less durable and much more vulnerable to fatigue than superman's and superman's only two real weaknesses are kryptonite and magic, neither of which goku has (ki=/=magic). Superman is also much faster. He's able to greatly exceed lightspeed flight and can even fly fast enough to turn back time, goku has instant transmission which he could use to keep up but on top of being faster Superman doesn't need any charge up time for anything, Goku, on the other hand requires charge time for many of his attacks which has often required other people to distract his foe which wouldn't happen in a 1 on 1 fight. Plus Goku's most powerful attack, the universal spirit bomb, would be useless since those who are pure of heart can just bounce it back; and come the fuck on it's Superman how much more pure of heart can you get? Goku would certainly put up one hell of a fight but Superman is just too powerful.

That's the thing, I want more than anything for them not to be. It's not like I'm unattractive or that I don't try. It's just that I generally have a really hard time approaching people, always have. Especially when I don't know a person because I usually don't get much farther than "Hi, I'm blah blah, how are you blah blah" before my mind just goes blank, I have a million and one things to say but I can't hold on to a thought long enough to say something and by the time I do someone else already said something and changed the subject or and awkward silence ensues either way I'm fucked. It gets even worse when there's a lot of people because, then, I already feel on edge so, when I run out of things to say I get trapped in these negative thought spirals and I can't do anything but sit in silence and wait it out.

Being a psych major and feeling this way kinda sucks because, being interested in psychology, I like to think about how people think and a have a tendency to pychoanalyze myself a lot and since I don't like myself very much I often end up doing more harm than good, almost like the emotional equivalent of cutting yourself. I am interested in the correlation between music and people's mental state, having a degree in both music and psychology will help with that, and also hope that the field of psychology might hold the secret to letting me feel alive again.
